key_facts: Rapid growth and extension of the lesion in June 2014
Location of the lesion: left anterior scalp, left parietal scalp, left forehead, left lateral cheek, right frontal scalp, and right parietal scalp
Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes
Cells had pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
Strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors

raw.rationale: The presence of irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes in the dermis, cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei, and strong immunopositivity for CD31 are characteristic of angiosarcoma, specifically cutaneous angiosarcoma given the location and description of the lesion.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as it does not specify the cutaneous nature of the tumor

rejected.label: Kaposi sarcoma
rejected.why: Typically associated with human herpesvirus 8 and has distinct histological features not mentioned in the case
